entities.summary: Bob Stapleton is an American entrepreneur and the former team owner of cycling team HTC–Highroad. Stapleton was previously the team manager of HTC–Highroad when it was known as T-Mobile Team. The transition to owner occurred on November 28, 2007 when German telecom company Deutsche Telekom ended its sponsorship after numerous doping allegations surfaced throughout 2007.
